title: Twisted-arrow coupling and its slice comparisons
statement:
Use quasicategories, simplicial operators and Kan mapping spaces of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], left fibrations of [def-coef-infinity-fibrations], and join slices of [lem-coef-infinity-slice-right-fibration]. For a simplicial set $K$, write $K^{\mathrm{op}}$ for the simplicial set with the same degree-$n$ sets and operators $d_i^{\mathrm{op}}=d_{n-i}$ and $s_i^{\mathrm{op}}=s_{n-i}$ in degree $n$. Let $\mathcal C$ be a quasicategory. Define $\operatorname{Tw}(\mathcal C)_n$ to be the maps $N([n]^{\mathrm{op}}\star[n])\to\mathcal C$, where the ordered join places every member of the first ordered set before every member of the second. For $\theta:[m]\to[n]$, its operator is precomposition with $N(\theta^{\mathrm{op}}\star\theta)$. Restriction to the two blocks gives
$$\lambda:\operatorname{Tw}(\mathcal C)\longrightarrow\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}}\times\mathcal C.$$
This is a left fibration. For a vertex $x$, define $(\mathcal C_{x/})_n$ by maps $\Delta^0\star\Delta^n\to\mathcal C$ constant at $x$ on the first point, with restriction operators and projection to the last block. Collapsing the first block gives an equivalence
$$\mathcal C_{x/}\longrightarrow\{x\}\times_{\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}}}\operatorname{Tw}(\mathcal C)$$
of quasicategories over $\mathcal C$. Collapsing the second block gives the dual equivalence
$$(\mathcal C_{/y})^{\mathrm{op}}\longrightarrow\operatorname{Tw}(\mathcal C)\times_{\mathcal C}\{y\}$$
over $\mathcal C^{\mathrm{op}}$. Both maps carry the identity-arrow vertex to the identity-arrow vertex. The constructions and maps commute with simplicial functors carrying the chosen vertices to the chosen vertices.
